name: TensorFold
description: LLM Inference Engine for Metal, CUDA and Vulkan.
one_liner: A lean engine for running AI language models on your own Mac or GPU, skipping the usual Python setup, so you can serve AI yourself instead of renting it from a cloud API.
buyer: An ML infrastructure engineer at a small AI product company who wants to self-host LLM inference cheaply on Apple Silicon or GPUs without the usual Python/MLX overhead.
business_use_cases: An AI startup self-hosting open-weight models shaves hosting costs by running leaner inference on Apple Silicon Mac minis instead of cloud GPUs.
A privacy-focused legal or healthcare SaaS runs inference fully on-prem with it to avoid sending client data to a third-party API.

money_ideas.idea: Paid 'cut your LLM hosting bill' consulting and migration service for companies on expensive cloud GPU inference

steal_this: Offer a 'cut your AI hosting bill' audit-and-migration weekend gig to small AI startups currently paying for cloud GPU inference.
